findings.title: The selected HTTP endpoint serves a successful plaintext response
findings.interpretation: This response was not an HTTPS redirect. It does not prove HTTPS is unavailable on another endpoint.
findings.remediation: For a public production endpoint, consider redirecting HTTP to HTTPS; review exceptions for local labs and health checks.

findings.title: No enforced CSP header was observed on this HTML response
findings.interpretation: A hardening observation, not evidence of XSS. A meta-delivered CSP may exist; response bodies are not inspected.
findings.remediation: Design and test an application-specific Content-Security-Policy, initially in report-only mode where appropriate.

findings.title: No recognized frame restriction header was observed
findings.interpretation: Neither a CSP frame-ancestors directive nor a recognized X-Frame-Options value was seen. No clickjacking impact was demonstrated.
findings.remediation: When embedding is not required, configure CSP frame-ancestors; otherwise explicitly allow the required embedding origins.

findings.title: X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff was not observed
findings.interpretation: A missing hardening control on this successful response, not a demonstrated content-sniffing exploit.
findings.remediation: Serve the correct Content-Type and configure X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff.

findings.title: Some response cookie attributes need a context-specific review
findings.interpretation: Cookie values, names, and purpose are unknown. JavaScript-readable cookies and default SameSite behavior can be intentional; no session compromise is claimed.
findings.remediation: For sensitive cookies, review Secure, HttpOnly, and SameSite against the application requirements.
